```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- read_json("data/wildfires.geojson")
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(first_fire)
first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coords) mean(map_dbl(coords[[1]], \(pt) pt[[1]]))),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coords) mean(map_dbl(coords[[1]], \(pt) pt[[2]])))
  )
```

```{r}
top_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10)

reduce(
  seq_len(nrow(top_fires)),
  .init = leaflet() |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap) |>
    setView(lng = -114, lat = 38, zoom = 5),
  \(m, i) {
    ring <- top_fires$geometry_coordinates[[i]][[1]]
    m |>
      addPolygons(
        lng = map_dbl(ring, \(pt) pt[[1]]),
        lat = map_dbl(ring, \(pt) pt[[2]]),
        popup = paste0(
          top_fires$incident[[i]], " (", top_fires$fire_year[[i]], "): ",
          format(round(top_fires$gis_acres[[i]]), big.mark = ","), " acres"
        )
      )
  }
)
```
